title: '04_figures'

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggflags)
library(ggh4x)

rm(list = ls())

```

```{r}
plot_wle <- function(table_wle, ylab, ylim = c(0, 8)) {

ggplot(table_wle, aes(x = as.factor(cohort_two), y = WLE, group = country_code, country = country_code)) +
  facet_grid(gender ~ country_group) +
  # Main data layers
  geom_point(data = table_wle %>% filter(projected == 0),
             size = 0.3) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = low, ymax = hig, alpha = 1)) +
  geom_line(data = table_wle %>% filter(projected == 0),
            linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_line(data = table_wle,
            linewidth = 0.4, linetype = "dotted") +
  # Flags at start and end
  geom_flag(data = table_wle %>% group_by(country_code, gender) %>% filter(cohort == min(cohort)) %>% slice(1),
            size = 3) +
  geom_flag(data = table_wle %>% group_by(country_code, gender) %>% filter(cohort_two == max(cohort_two)) %>% slice(1),
            size = 3) +
  # Theme and Styling
  theme_linedraw(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95", colour = "black"),
    strip.text = element_text(colour = "black", face = "bold", size = 10),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", colour = "black"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", colour = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1, size = 8, colour = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9, colour = "black"),
    axis.line = element_line(),
    axis.ticks = element_line(),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  guides(x = "axis_minor", y = "axis_minor") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim) +
  scale_y_continuous(ylab, breaks = seq(-10, 10, 1)) +
  scale_x_discrete("Birth Cohort", labels = function(x) ifelse(seq_along(x) %% 2 == 0, x, "")) +
  scale_alpha(range = c(0.01, 0.1))

}

read_results <- function(file) {

results <- read.csv(file)

results <- results %>%
  mutate(
    gender = fct_relevel(as.factor(gender), "Women"),
    country_group = factor(country_group, levels = c("Northern Europe", "Western Europe", "Southern Europe", "Central and Eastern Europe")))

return(results)

}

```

# Figures 1 to 5: Age group 55 to 64
```{r, warning = F}
results <- read_results("outputs/estimates_55_64.csv")

p <- plot_wle(results %>% filter(var == "wle"), "WLE (years)")
ggsave("outputs/fig1_wle_55_64.tiff", p, width = 8.5, height = 5.7)

p <- plot_wle(results %>% filter(var == "wle_adjusted"), "aWLE (FTE years)")
ggsave("outputs/fig2_wle_adjusted_55_64.tiff", p, width = 8.5, height = 5.7)

p <- plot_wle(results %>% filter(var == "wyl_retirement"), "WYL (years)")
ggsave("outputs/fig3_wyl_retirement_55_64.tiff", p, width = 8.5, height = 5.7)

p <- plot_wle(results %>% filter(var == "wyl_unemployment"), "WYL (years)")
ggsave("outputs/fig4_wyl_unemployment_55_64.tiff", p, width = 8.5, height = 5.7)

p <- plot_wle(results %>% filter(var == "wyl_inactivity"), "WYL (years)")
ggsave("outputs/fig5_wyl_inactivity_55_64.tiff", p, width = 8.5, height = 5.7)

```
